description: AI Overview presence trend across a tracker's keywords, oldest first — what share of tracked keywords showed Google's AI Overview in the SERP, per check run, and how that has moved over time. FREE: database only, no SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent. Reuses `rank_snapshots.serpFeatures`, already populated by the SERP-feature capture the rank checker already does — no new SERP calls. `aiOverviewPresenceRatePct` is `keywordsWithAiOverview / keywordsTotal * 100`, rounded to one decimal, and `null` (not 0) for a run where `keywordsTotal` is 0 — nothing was checked that run, which is a missing measurement, not a truthful "0% presence".

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

device.description: On every free SERP source today this narrows nothing — there is no device dimension, so every reading folds to one series regardless of what is passed. Defaults to desktop.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

sinceDays.description: How many days back to look, 1–730. Defaults to 365.

name: get_rank_ai_overview_trend
